subject: malloc: Complete allocator header and test availability
author: fuzailmansuri <mfm9875@gmail.com>
reported_failures: libasync_safe product variant could not resolve libhardened_malloc_headers
The inherited header dependency lacked com.android.adbd APEX availability and a minimum SDK
Windows HMallocTest depended on disabled Tradefed libraries
fixes: Expose the header module to product and vendor consumers
Allow header use in any APEX and inherit its minimum SDK
Disable only the unsupported Windows HMallocTest variant

validation.method: Reran the reported Soong graph-generation action with the existing soong_build executable

limits: Successful graph generation does not establish native or Java compilation, final OTA success or boot
Linux host and arm64 MTE tests remain in the graph but were not executed
Frankel graph generation and hardware behavior were not tested
